steps.message: I have implemented the `isatty` method in `FileProxy` to correctly proxy the call to the underlying file object, bypassing the default `False` return value from `io.TextIOBase`.

The issue was that `FileProxy` inherited from `io.TextIOBase`, which provides a default `isatty()` method that returns `False`. As a result, `FileProxy.isatty()` always returned `False` even if the underlying file object it was proxying had an `isatty()` method that returned `True`. This prevented `rich` and other tools from correctly detecting if the proxied output was a TTY. I fixed this by explicitly implementing the `isatty()` method in `FileProxy` to delegate the call to the underlying file object.
